services.name: Tickets
services.desc: go on sale on the Monday 11 days prior to each show’s opening date. Our doors open 30 minutes prior to curtain time. All seating is general admission. Curtain times are 7:30 p.m. for evening performances and 2:30 p.m. for Sunday matinees. Pull-Tight Players does not issue ticket refunds, only exchanges up to 48 hours before your scheduled performance. See above. We are happy to accommodate our guests with mobility challenges who need accessible seating. This seating is limited and only reserved upon request for ADA-qualifying patrons.
